descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
We are looking for a Java Software Engineer to join our team. 
 Job description: 
Coding implements technical specifications, integrates, corrects code, tests
Discussing the technical and functional specifications with the client
Analysis, design, implementation
Help the juniors
 You need to know: 
Minimum 4 years of experience with Java 8 & 21 and Spring Boot
Angular or React
 Nice to have any of the following: 
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift
DevOps: Experience working with DevOps principles, including creating/using CI/CD pipelines
Kafka
 Language Requirements: 
Advanced English
French language is a big plus, but not mandatory
 Hybrid work with 3 days in the office in either Bucharest/Timisoara/Cluj/Brasov 
 Why should you join us?
We have a solid company (projects that last minimum one year), and employees stay with us on average for about 10 years
We have many projects (50+) and lots of career opportunities. After you finish your first project, for the next one you can choose to master the skills that you already know, or learn new technologies on the next one. This way, you do not have to change the company, just the project
Reimbursement of agreed certifications
Private medical subscription
Team buildings
